evidence.summary: Round 3 closes PERF finding 3a (pooled backend's leftover '' read as deny-all) by making '' open and writing the '!' sentinel for no lines from every scoped transaction, and 3b (shipment_evidence_current owned by postgres bypassed RLS) by security_invoker=true, kept by the view refresh code. Proven on cip_test (parity: '!' sees only NULL-product rows on every table; view honours the caller's scope). New fail-open hazard from '' = open is covered: the after_begin listener rebinds every transaction, and the extended DB test shows a one-line user still sees only that line after a commit leaves ''; without the listener it sees all (18 vs 2). Edit now also requires read (stricter than 0024 on cip, unreachable from the app).

rationale: The access semantics are unchanged for every scope the app produces and two holes are closed. Limitation, stated: cip is still at 0024, so 3b is live on cip until Warren runs the hand-off command (smoke run shows the view returns 15,807 rows under '!'); the hand-off restarts the API before migrating so no running process writes '' once '' means open.
